title: Forecasts from the Period of the Previous Year
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:42 AM

MR Result 0       80               2? kW

|_— $———_—_——
MR Reas. |                             Y                                                           P
08                            09                                                          01

200                                       220                 kW/Year
PerDem,§ |]

Wght Unit             400

Wght Port.              40%

On installation of the device, a period demand value of 200 kWh/year is entered for the register. This value is changed to 220 kWh
/ year after the last meter reading result entry in period 09 to O1.

The minimum portion of weighting in percent is 30%.

The sum of the weighting units for one year is 1000.

With a weighting portion of 40%, period Y to | is representative. One period consumption change was made in the forecast period
O09 to O1. The expected meter reading is determined based on the period demand and equals 220 kW .

Forecasts from the Period of the Previous Year

If you include periods of the previous year as the base period category in the installation, the expected meter reading values are
extrapolated based on the corresponding period of the previous year .

For the forecast from the period of the previous year, the search algorithm for demand registers differs from the search algorithm
for consumption registers as follows:

Demand Registers                                                            Consumption Registers

The system only looks for meter reading results in the previous           The system goes back one year from the forecast date and looks
year with the same allocation month as the expected meter              for a representative period

readings

It is not important whether the period of previous year is                    It is important that the period of previous year is representative

representative

If no corresponding period of the previous year is available, extrapolation is based on the previous period.
